progression.narrative: The performance opens on B3 and dwells most on B in Phrase 1. Phrase 3 (0:22.1) introduces Bb, centred on B. Phrase 4 (0:30.1) introduces Eb, E, Gb, Gs, centred on Gs. Phrase 7 (1:04.8) introduces Cs, centred on B. The line peaks at Cs5 (517.6 Hz) at 2:29.5. It closes on the tonic (Gb4 → Gb4 → Cs4 → B2 → B2 → B2).
